learn: Every computer does four jobs: it takes input, processes it, gives output and stores data.
Pressing a key is input. The processor works out which letter it is. The letter on the screen is output. Saving the file is storage.
This cycle happens millions of times a second.

learn: Memory (RAM) holds what the computer is using right now. It empties when the power goes off.

More memory lets a computer run more things at once.
